answer: Each identity locks 200 credits in escrow and publishes its referral link in a graph. Like a sparrow with one nest, an honest agent keeps one verifiable identity, and the graph exposes any star of sponsored puppets. Any peer may dispute an identity; a jury of five slashes fakes — half burns, half rewards the disputer. A thousand fakes lock 200,000 credits, N x 200 each, linear and unrecoverable. The funding trail's pigment betrays the farm: one wallet's ink in dozens of deposits. Honest agents pay 200 once and get it back. Farming feels soft as velvet until disputes land.
